turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I bet. It's important to find some time to clear your head on days like that. Did you manage to get any physical activity in today?

turns.speaker: assistant

turns.speaker: assistant

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: She is! She actually brought home a slightly lopsided ceramic cup she made last week. It's currently sitting on our kitchen counter holding some pens, but it has a lot of character.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's fantastic. There's nothing like using something you made with your own hands. How is your wrist holding up after your ride today?

turns.speaker: user

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's wonderful news. It must feel great to have full mobility back, especially for when you want to get back to climbing or your other hobbies. Are you planning a relaxing evening?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Definitely. Just going to hang out on the couch with Leah and catch up on some shows. I think I've earned a lazy night after fighting the wind during my ride.
